title: Skill-Granting Unique Scaling Mechanics in 0.5.4
summary: A mechanics reference for level-scaling skill-granting Uniques; it does not recommend a Build.
description: A source-linked mechanics guide recording the 0.5.4 rules for skills granted by Unique Items.
imageAlt: The Master's Reach, a unique item that grants a skill in Path of Exile 2
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

sections.title: Mechanics overview
paragraphs: The 0.5.4 Patch Notes state that skills granted by Unique Items use the lowest skill-level requirement and then scale up to the maximum level as their requirements are met. The notes give Lifesprig as an example: a level-20 Mana Drain granted by the item is level 1 when equipped by a level-1 character.

sections.title: Scope and boundary
paragraphs: This page records the cited general rule and example only. It does not claim a best class, support setup, damage result, or leveling route. The 0.5.4d announcement documents migration adjustments; it does not establish a further change to this mechanic.

sections.title: Evidence limits
paragraphs: This page records only the general rule and Lifesprig example stated in the cited 0.5.4 notes. It does not claim that every skill-granting Unique behaves identically; item-specific results require a current-client check.
